message: Security schemes can't be marked deprecated in the app: legacyKey
The app has no operations like these, so they were left out: QUERY /products and PURGE /products
Examples of parameters and headers keep their values, in the schema's examples; their names, summaries, and descriptions aren't kept (1 place: sort (GET /products))
Response summaries aren't kept (1 response: GET /products 200)
in: querystring parameters aren't kept (1 parameter: query (GET /search))
1 response without a description got one from its status: GET /search 200: OK

2 tags (catalog and products) weren't imported: OpenAPI tags group operations, and a project's pages are the screens that call them, so the endpoints start without pages. The Export tab lists them as unused until pages link them.
